description: Designed by scripts/director.py design (seed 147): the roles, ages, styles and colours were dealt by code, the rooms written from the picture of the wallpaper by a model; each slot carries its own kit. Re-shoot under a NEW set name.

kit.name: Birch flower table and poufs
kit.subject: a bright IKEA Kids bedroom for a child aged 2 to 5, with a flower-shaped craft table and poufs
kit.room: A light room with a pine plank floor.
kit.floor: A powder blue cotton rug with wax crayons in a wooden cup and an open drawing book.
kit.side_wall: a low flower-shaped birch craft table, a stack of ochre and barberry bouclé poufs and a low white bed with powder blue bedding
kit.light: Soft afternoon light from a window on the {side} lies in patches on the floor.
kit.palette: powder blue, pale birch, ochre, barberry red and white
kit.items: flower-shaped craft table, bouclé poufs, low white bed, rug, crayon cup, drawing book, picture frame and architecture
kit.life_pose: {person} stands on the rug with {her} back to the camera, {her} face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible.
kit.toy: wax crayons in a wooden cup with an open drawing book on the rug

kit.name: Sage nursery corner with quilted mat
kit.subject: a calm Playful Curves nursery for a baby under 2, with a round quilted mat and a low birch book ledge
kit.room: A quiet cream room with a pale ash herringbone floor.
kit.floor: A cream oval rug with scalloped edges holds a wooden push-along walker cart and a few wooden blocks beside the cot.
kit.side_wall: a round quilted sage organic cotton mat with wooden sensory blocks, a low birch book ledge with two board books, and a slatted birch cot 120 by 60 cm with sage bedding
kit.light: Warm morning sunbeams from a window on the {side} lie in soft patches on the floor.
kit.palette: muted sage, cream, pale birch, soft clay pink, butter yellow and white
kit.items: quilted mat, sensory blocks, book ledge, slatted cot, walker cart, wooden blocks, oval rug, picture frame and architecture
kit.life_pose: {person} stands on the rug with {her} back to the camera, {her} face turned away from the camera so no facial detail is visible.
kit.toy: a wooden push-along walker cart with a few wooden blocks standing on the floor beside the cot
